verification.method: exact rational Walsh laws, upper masses and influences plus deterministic binary logarithms

normalization_and_terminal_terms: The law is normalized exactly: p+(2^(n-1)-1)q=1.
Upper masses count the actual translated parity coset; inclusion is not treated as translation invariant.
Separating coordinates retain and average both nonterminal point-defect children.
Nonseparating coordinates retain the active two-defect child and the zero-U character terminal.
Mask weight changes only on coordinates physically belonging to the mask.
The unmasked one-defect theorem is imported from its original proof and used with its exact sharp constant.
obstruction_controls: No favorable sign, fixed-sign projection, unsigned coefficient-four bound, or unproved coefficient repair is used.
Negative G values are allowed and never converted to absolute values.
The proper-class theorem is not labeled universal GU or full FEI.
Finite enumeration reconstructs the kernel but is not used for all-dimensional inference.
remaining_obstacle: Control arbitrary defect sets whose two physical children retain unrelated multi-defect upper-set geometries, with one source-influence/terminal-reserve budget.
next_action: Derive the exact three-defect recursion (one-defect versus two-defect children) and isolate a normalized defect-set score whose coefficient can plausibly remain independent of defect count.
